#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <map>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <climits>

using namespace std;

int r, c;
long long C[64][64];
long long best = LLONG_MAX;

int cntA[64], cntB[64];
map<long long, long long> cache;
string cs;

void dfs(long long x, long long y, int v1, int v2) {
    long long d = llabs(x - y);
    if (best <= 1 || d - C[v1][r] * C[v2][r] >= best) return;
    if (v1 == r - 1 && v2 == r - 1) {
        if (d < best) best = d;
        return;
    }
    if (v1 >= r) {
        long long c1 = C[v1][r] - C[v1 - 1][r], s2 = C[v2][r];
        dfs(x, y + c1 * s2, v1 - 1, v2);
    }
    if (v2 >= r) {
        long long s1 = C[v1][r], c2 = C[v2][r] - C[v2 - 1][r];
        dfs(x + s1 * c2, y, v1, v2 - 1);
    }
}

long long solve(long long x, long long y, int v1, int v2) {
    long long k = x * 10000 + v1 * 100 + v2;
    auto it = cache.find(k);
    if (it != cache.end()) return it->second;
    long long v = 0;
    long long d = llabs(x - y);
    if (d - C[v1][r] * C[v2][r] > best) {
        cache[k] = v;
        return v;
    }
    if (v1 < r || v2 < r) {
        int sum = v1 + v2;
        if (v1 >= cntA[sum] && v2 >= cntB[sum]) {
            v1 -= cntA[sum];
            v2 -= cntB[sum];
            v = C[v1 + v2][v1];
            cache[k] = v;
            return v;
        }
        cache[k] = v;
        return v;
    }
    char c = cs[v1 + v2 - 1];
    if (c != 'B') {
        long long c1 = C[v1][r] - C[v1 - 1][r], s2 = C[v2][r];
        v += solve(x, y + c1 * s2, v1 - 1, v2);
    }
    if (c != 'A') {
        long long s1 = C[v1][r], c2 = C[v2][r] - C[v2 - 1][r];
        v += solve(x + s1 * c2, y, v1, v2 - 1);
    }
    cache[k] = v;
    return v;
}

void start() {
    cin >> r >> c;
    cin.ignore();
    getline(cin, cs);
    for (int i = 0; i <= 2 * (r + c); i++)
        for (int j = 0; j <= 2 * (r + c); j++) {
            if (j == 0) C[i][j] = 1;
            else if (i == 0) C[i][j] = 0;
            else C[i][j] = C[i - 1][j - 1] + C[i - 1][j];
        }
    int v1 = r + c, v2 = r + c;
    long long x = 0, y = 0;
    while (v1 >= r && v2 >= r) {
        if (x > y) {
            long long c1 = C[v1][r] - C[v1 - 1][r], s2 = C[v2][r];
            y += c1 * s2;
            v1--;
        } else {
            long long s1 = C[v1][r], c2 = C[v2][r] - C[v2 - 1][r];
            x += s1 * c2;
            v2--;
        }
    }
    best = llabs(x - y);
    dfs(0, 0, r + c, r + c);
    for (int i = 0; i < 2 * (r + c); i++) {
        cntA[i + 1] = cntA[i] + (cs[i] == 'A' ? 1 : 0);
        cntB[i + 1] = cntB[i] + (cs[i] == 'B' ? 1 : 0);
    }
    long long ans = solve(0, 0, r + c, r + c);
    cout << ans << endl;
}

int main() {
    start();
    return 0;
}
